name: groth16-verifier-baseline
description: Baseline Groth16 (circom/snarkjs) tren cung quan he chung minh cua bai — de doi chung gas xac thuc voi nhanh Halo2

scripts.circuit:compile: npm run mkbuild && circom circuits/withdraw.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build
scripts.setup:ptau: npm run mkbuild && snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 14 build/pot14_0000.ptau && snarkjs powersoftau contribute build/pot14_0000.ptau build/pot14_0001.ptau --name="baseline" -e="baseline-groth16-2026" && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 build/pot14_0001.ptau build/pot14_final.ptau && npm run setup:verify-ptau
scripts.setup:zkey: snarkjs groth16 setup build/withdraw.r1cs build/pot14_final.ptau build/withdraw_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute build/withdraw_0000.zkey build/withdraw_final.zkey --name="baseline" -e="baseline-groth16-2026" && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/withdraw_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.setup:verifier: snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier build/withdraw_final.zkey contracts/contracts/Groth16Verifier.sol
scripts.chain: npx ganache --port 8546 --wallet.totalAccounts 501 --wallet.mnemonic "test test test test test test test test test test test junk"
